messages:
maria: NovaHealth POC kickoff tomorrow 10:00am PT. They want validation of three flows: symptom triage, referral routing, appointment summarization. Need a prompt inventory and baseline prompts before the call. Who can own the inventory?

jake: I got this — I'll gather seed prompts. Confirm flow priority?

samir: I'll run baseline evals. What are the success metrics we should target (accuracy, hallucination, latency, cost)?

maria: Priority order: 1) symptom triage 2) referral routing 3) appointment summarization. Draft success criteria:
- Intent accuracy >= 90% on labeled set
- No high-severity PHI leaks on random sample (0/1000)
- p95 latency < 600ms
- Effective token cost < $0.03 per response-token
Thoughts?

elaine: For pricing, recommend hosted to move fast; Dedicated if they absolutely need isolation. Typical POC length 4 weeks. I'll estimate hosted vs dedicated costs after traffic mapping.

jake: Proposed inventory CSV header:
```
use_case,flow_step,role,seed_prompt,expected_output_example,eval_labels
```
I'll drop first 30 seed prompts into the shared sheet.

jake: Example row:
```
symptom_triage,user_question,assistant,System: You are a medical triage assistant...\nUser: I'm dizzy and nauseous,suggested_next_steps: ['advise urgent care','schedule telemed'],intent:vertigo;urgency:medium
```

samir: Eval harness will measure intent_f1, hallucination_rate (binary per example), avg_latency, token_cost. I'll include adversarial/ambiguous samples.

sec-team: PHI guidance: for HIPAA-compliant handling we recommend Private (VPC) with customer-managed KMS. Dedicated + BAA + strict logging might be acceptable depending on legal. We'll draft the questionnaire responses and propose deployment options. ETA EOD.

elaine: Flagging data residency Q6 for legal. Also request NovaHealth share ~100 representative utterances per flow if available.

jake: Link to sheet (placeholder): https://redwood.app/sheets/novah-prompt-inventory

maria: Owners: jake (prompt inventory), samir (baseline evals), sec-team (security questionnaire), elaine (pricing/legal). Jake/samir -- first draft by EOD tomorrow so we can review before kickoff. :thumbsup:

sec-team: Acknowledged. We'll attach deployment recommendation in the questionnaire. :eyes:
